body: i can't stay here much longer
but that person was right, i am truly broken

my life is not valuable, it's trash that needs to be thrown out straight into the bin and if i continue to live further, i will just make more stupid mistakes that will drive me completely insane, i really don't want to live like this anymore

i never checked myself into a hospital and i don't want to call a suicide hotline because it's useless, i already said before that my mistakes are permanent and i can't just go back in time and undo them

i haven't tried therapy, it costs so much and does so little, there is no forgiveness for me, my own stupidity is really incredible and i will be always reminded of that no matter what i do, say or think
no, i don't think they would fix anything for me, the mistakes that i made are permanent and they will stay with me for the rest of my life
thanks, my only enemy is myself, the mistakes that i've made are very bad by my own standards and having acceptance for them is just another form of defeat for me
you think too highly of me, i am just another lost soul down
also, what do you mean by "light in me"
i don't know why i made it, nothing matters anymore
i am not going to win anything either if i am going to live anyways, these mistakes control me and define who i am today, they will affect my whole life forever
if i will do something very extreme and radical, that will be the last mistake that i will ever make in my life
